representations.name: Boolean Fourier spectrum of the actual quotient code
representations.new_information: Treats the row set as a measure on normalized divisor vectors y in {0,1}^D and records Walsh coefficients decorated by factor augmentations, widths and paired-positive carrier counts.
representations.repairs_loss: Can detect correlations among rows that pointwise subset recovery erases.
representations.first_test: The uniform cube and middle layers have explicit low-degree spectra while supporting exponentially many rows; kill any compression from Fourier degree alone.
representations.exponent_interface: A theorem must force a fixed-power row saving or an all-target fibre saving, not merely reconstruct y.

representations.name: Noise stability and factor influence profile
representations.new_information: Records noise stability, coordinate influences and paired-product carrier sensitivity under one-factor switches.
representations.repairs_loss: Tests whether paired positivity makes the actual quotient code less cube-like than Phi6.
representations.first_test: Use subcubes, Hamming balls and the small-D translation pair; reject low influence or high stability as rigidity without common-X/unit input.
representations.exponent_interface: Any junta dimension and exceptional mass must be o(log t) while retaining K=t^(5/9-o(1)) rows.

representations.name: Unit-aware logarithmic derivative moments
representations.new_information: Records Q'_j/Q_j at controlled positive characters together with the Laurent unit exponent, poles, zeros and factor labels, so multiplication is additive without discarding translation.
representations.repairs_loss: Restores the unit parameter missing from normalized root data and can compare factor shapes beyond width.
representations.first_test: Test characters at zeros and near-collisions; require a t^o(1) exceptional-set proof and replay translated interval blocks.
representations.exponent_interface: The number of characters, singular patterns and unit fibres must be t^o(1), followed by a proved Euclidean consequence.

representations.name: Common-root multiplicity and resultant incidence
representations.new_information: Builds a row-by-root multiplicity matrix for Q_j, R_j and both positive products, retaining resultants with scalar-copy masks.
representations.repairs_loss: Distinguishes factor occurrence equality from analytic coincidence after scaling and exposes shared cyclotomic or noncyclotomic roots.
representations.first_test: Independent formal factors and same-line cyclotomic rows must show that root multiplicity alone need not control Euclidean labels.
representations.exponent_interface: A surviving resultant gap must exclude t^(5/9-o(1)) rows or propagate to full qU target fibres.

representations.name: Subset-poset shadows with paired-positive decoration
representations.new_information: Places quotient vectors in the divisor poset and decorates covers, shadows and diamonds by whether both F_0Q and RQ remain collision-free masks.
representations.repairs_loss: Uses correlations between neighbouring divisor choices rather than unlabelled code size.
representations.first_test: Phi6 middle layers and direct-product masks realize large shadows and many diamonds; kill incidence-only shadow bounds.
representations.exponent_interface: A forbidden-pattern theorem must use common-X anchoring and save a fixed power over K, not a logarithmic factor.

representations.name: Four-row poset cumulants
representations.new_information: Measures signed four-row cumulants on Boolean rectangles together with coefficient-carrier overlap in both positive products.
representations.repairs_loss: Can detect reuse or incompatibility invisible to one-row moments and pairwise factor overlap.
representations.first_test: Tensor-product Boolean rectangles have nontrivial cumulants but no common-X geometry; translated exact blocks test unit sensitivity.
representations.exponent_interface: A cumulant lower bound must convert to scarce actual carriers or distance fibres with a complete multiplicity ledger.

representations.name: Laurent-unit augmented Boolean host
representations.new_information: Extends y by the exact Laurent monomial/sign unit of Q_j and the compensating units of R_j, G and F_0, preserving absolute coefficient locations.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes coefficient moments and paired-positive products reconstructible from the normalized host.
representations.first_test: The length-12 exact interval block under source translations must be represented with distinct units although its normalized Boolean vectors are identical.
representations.exponent_interface: Common-X must bound unit entropy by t^o(1) or show that unit variation itself forces a full-target distance gain.

representations.name: Normalized-data collision adversary pair
representations.new_information: Compares exact blocks with identical normalized quotient vectors, factor roots and per-row spectra but different source translations and target-target collision sets.
representations.repairs_loss: Directly tests whether a proposed moment conclusion is invariant under the data forgotten by normalization.
representations.first_test: Use X_t={t,t+1}, scalars 1,2,3 and a length-12 common spectrum; exact target-label counts are 127 at t=0 and 145 at t=-1/4.
representations.exponent_interface: A theorem surviving this pair must either include units or prove a conclusion uniform across every unit fibre.

representations.name: Moment-to-full-target collision energy
representations.new_information: Couples a factor moment statistic on the selected K rows to the energy of the actual squared-distance map on all qU targets.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents a selected-chart statistic from being declared useful before propagation to the only pair domain above exponent three.
representations.first_test: The unit-translation pair has identical normalized moments but different finite collision energy; require the exact propagation map.
representations.exponent_interface: Must prove all-target average fibre exponent below 1/9-epsilon; selected-to-all capacity 53/18 cannot close.

representations.name: Conditional moment profile versus distance-fibre duality
representations.new_information: Forms a primal quotient-profile partition and a dual certificate charging every large distance fibre to a bounded number of unit-aware moment profiles.
representations.repairs_loss: Creates a single ledger in which row compression and collision control are alternative outcomes.
representations.first_test: Small-D translated blocks and Phi6 must expose profiles that are algebraically identical yet have unrelated collision fibres unless the dual uses actual coordinates.
representations.exponent_interface: Profile ambiguity times fibre size must be t^(1/9-epsilon), with every factor derived on the full target graph.
